title: Watch board changes and trigger local actions
description: Opt-in snapshot watcher with filtered board events, process and webhook actions, and explicit security and delivery limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Implement an opt-in watcher with safe local action configuration and documented delivery limitations.
Verify behavior and document tested integration recipes.

notes: Full bun test: 203 pass, 0 fail, including UI; two Opus reviews completed. Local process and local T3 webhook task verified end to end; public T3 Connect and signed delivery untested. Follow-up AB-C8A90D1C7747 tracks lock interruption and EPIPE regression coverage.

thread.body: Dogfood verified: vendored watcher observed this card's thread update and delivered card.updated with revision, thread and updatedAt fields to a local Bun process. Local webhook receiver and process actions also covered by automated tests; no external T3 integration tested.

thread.body: Verified live locally: vendored watcher POSTed card.updated to a temporary T3 webhook task; T3 accepted the event and its agent returned the matching JSON. Temporary task removed. Public T3 Connect and signed delivery were not tested.
